description: Use when the user wants to exchange rubles, RUB or SBP QR for USDT (TRC20, TON, Polygon, BEP20, ERC20). Resolves Russian and English currency terms and returns the live SAIKYO quote and order link.

amount.description: Amount in the currency chosen by amount_side.

amount_side.description: Whether amount is the amount paid (give) or received (get). Defaults to give.

get.description: What the user wants to receive: "USDT", "тезер", "TRC20".

give.description: What the user pays, in any language: "рубли", "RUB", "СБП".
